text: This is probably me overreacting but I'm looking after my nephew Callum tonight, he's 4. His temp was 39.1 about an hour ago. Then while he was on the sofa he went stiff and started shaking all over and his eyes rolled up. It lasted maybe a minute? He's never done anything like that before, ever. Afterwards I took his top off to cool him down and there are these little dark red-purple dots on his chest and a couple of bigger bits that look like bruises. I pressed a glass on them like you see online and they're still there through the glass, they don't go away. His mum's on a night shift and I don't want to panic her for nothing. Is this something or am I being daft
